capabilities: Color LaTeX and MathJax equations semantically in Live Preview and Reading View without modifying notes
Jump from any rendered symbol to its exact LaTeX source span via click-to-edit navigation
Convert Typst-style and shift-free shorthands into canonical LaTeX while typing
Show a floating rendered math preview tooltip and squiggly syntax warnings in Live Preview
Bake \textcolor wrappers into notes for export and strip them back out
extras: Includes a detailed benchmark ledger and performance claims; a Rust/WASM accelerator is described as an experimental feature preview; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author found monochrome LaTeX equations visually dense and mentally exhausting to parse, so equations are colored semantically in real time.
problem: Obsidian renders math as monochrome LaTeX, making dense equations hard to distinguish by operators, variables, functions, and differentials.

relations.evidence: Hooks directly into Obsidian's internal MathJax rendering engine.

summary: Semantic colorer for LaTeX and MathJax equations that adds Typst-style input shorthands, click-to-source navigation, and optional baked \textcolor markup.
